whoItsFor: Developers who want a terminal coding agent that uses the same language servers, debuggers, and tooling as their IDE. It also suits anyone who wants parallel subagents or automated code review on real codebases.
useCases: Making code edits that land on the first try, using content-hash anchors instead of retyped lines
Renaming symbols or moving files with LSP updating imports and re-exports across the project
Debugging a crashing or hung native, Go, or Python process by attaching a live debugger
